quests.instruction: Which word describes an official paper allowing a new driver to practice with an adult?
quests.hint: Think about the paper a new driver needs before they are allowed to practice driving with an adult beside them.
quests.explanation: A permit is an official paper allowing practice driving. New drivers use a permit before earning a full license!
quests.funFact: A learner's permit lets a new driver safely practice with an experienced adult in the car!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the careful check travelers go through before boarding a flight?
quests.hint: Think about the careful check at the airport where bags are scanned before you walk to your gate.
quests.explanation: A security check is a careful check before boarding a flight. Security checks help keep every flight safe!
quests.funFact: Airport security teams work hard every day to help keep every single traveler safe!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the specific door where passengers wait to walk onto their airplane?
quests.hint: Think about the specific numbered door at the airport where you wait before walking onto your plane.
quests.explanation: A boarding gate is the door where passengers board a plane. Every flight has its own numbered boarding gate!
quests.funFact: Checking the airport screens helps travelers find their correct boarding gate quickly!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the area at an airport where you collect your suitcase after landing?
quests.hint: Think about the area with the spinning conveyor belt where you wait to grab your suitcase after a flight.
quests.explanation: Baggage claim is the area for collecting suitcases after landing. Travelers wait here for their luggage!
quests.funFact: Watching a big conveyor belt slowly circle around is part of waiting at baggage claim!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the official check travelers go through when entering a new country?
quests.hint: Think about the official check at the airport that happens right after you land in a new country.
quests.explanation: Customs is the official check when entering a new country. Travelers pass through customs after landing!
quests.funFact: Customs officers help make sure that everything travelers bring into a country is safe!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a carefully planned journey made to explore or discover somewhere new?
quests.hint: Think about a carefully planned adventure made to explore somewhere wild and undiscovered.
quests.explanation: An expedition is a carefully planned journey to explore somewhere new. Explorers go on an expedition to discover new places!
quests.funFact: Famous expeditions have explored mountains, oceans, and even the icy poles of the Earth!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a journey that goes somewhere and then returns all the way back home?
quests.hint: Think about a trip where you travel somewhere fun and then travel all the way back home again.
quests.explanation: A round trip is a journey that goes somewhere and comes back. Round trips include both directions of travel!
quests.funFact: Booking a round trip ticket usually covers both the trip there and the trip back home!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a ticket for a trip in just one direction, with no return included?
quests.hint: Think about a ticket that only covers the trip there, with no return trip included at all.
quests.explanation: A one-way ticket covers travel in just one direction. One-way tickets do not include a return trip!
quests.funFact: People moving to a brand new city often buy a one-way ticket instead of a round trip!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the official booklet that lets a traveler enter other countries?
quests.hint: Think about the small official booklet with your photo that you show when entering another country.
quests.explanation: A passport is an official booklet for entering other countries. Travelers carry a passport on international trips!
quests.funFact: A passport shows a traveler's photo and important details to prove exactly who they are!

quests.instruction: Which word means stepping aboard a ship or plane at the very start of a journey?
quests.hint: Think about the exact moment you step onto a ship, right at the very beginning of your voyage.
quests.explanation: Embark means to step aboard a ship or plane to begin a journey. Passengers embark before a voyage starts!
quests.funFact: Sailors often say a cheerful goodbye to loved ones on the dock just before they embark!

quests.instruction: Which word means stepping off a ship or plane at the end of a journey?
quests.hint: Think about the exact moment you finally step off the ship at the very end of your voyage.
quests.explanation: Disembark means to step off a ship or plane at journey's end. Passengers disembark once they reach the dock!
quests.funFact: Passengers usually disembark in a careful, orderly line to keep everyone moving safely!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a printed schedule showing exactly when buses or trains arrive and depart?
quests.hint: Think about the printed chart at a station showing exactly what time every train comes and goes.
quests.explanation: A timetable is a schedule showing arrival and departure times. Timetables help travelers plan their trip!
quests.funFact: Checking a timetable ahead of time helps travelers avoid missing their bus or train!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a group of vehicles traveling together for safety or organization?
quests.hint: Think about a long line of trucks traveling together down the highway, one right after another.
quests.explanation: A convoy is a group of vehicles traveling together. Convoys often travel together for safety or organization!
quests.funFact: Traveling in a convoy can help a group of vehicles stay safely together on a long trip!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a group of vehicles, or a towable home on wheels, traveling together?
quests.hint: Think about a group of campers traveling together, or a cozy towable home pulled behind a car.
quests.explanation: A caravan is a group of traveling vehicles, or a towable home. Families often tow a caravan on vacation!
quests.funFact: A caravan gives a family a comfortable little home to bring along on their road trip!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a whole group of vehicles owned and operated together, like a company's taxis?
quests.hint: Think about all the matching taxis or delivery trucks owned by the very same company.
quests.explanation: A fleet is a whole group of vehicles owned together. A taxi company's fleet includes all of its cars!
quests.funFact: A large delivery company might operate a fleet of thousands of trucks all across the country!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the special recorder on a plane that saves flight information for safety?
quests.hint: Think about the tough, protected recorder hidden inside a plane that saves important flight information.
quests.explanation: A black box is a recorder that saves flight information. Black boxes help experts learn about a flight's safety!
quests.funFact: A black box is actually painted bright orange to help it be found easily, not black at all!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the technology that uses radio waves to detect distant airplanes or ships?
quests.hint: Think about the spinning dish at an airport that sends out signals to detect faraway airplanes.
quests.explanation: Radar is technology that detects distant vehicles using radio waves. Radar helps track airplanes and ships!
quests.funFact: Radar was first developed to help detect airplanes from very far away!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the technology that uses sound waves to detect things underwater?
quests.hint: Think about the technology a submarine uses, sending out sound waves that bounce back off things underwater.
quests.explanation: Sonar is technology that detects underwater objects using sound. Submarines use sonar to see underwater!
quests.funFact: Sonar works a lot like how a bat uses sound to find its way in the dark!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the system that can fly a plane automatically without a pilot's constant control?
quests.hint: Think about the system a pilot switches on to let the plane fly itself smoothly for a while.
quests.explanation: Autopilot is a system that flies a plane automatically. Pilots can switch on autopilot during a long flight!
quests.funFact: Even with autopilot on, a pilot always stays ready to take back control at any moment!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the car feature that keeps a steady speed without the driver pressing the gas?
quests.hint: Think about the car feature a driver switches on during a long highway trip to hold a steady speed.
quests.explanation: Cruise control is a feature that holds a steady speed. Drivers use cruise control on long highway trips!
quests.funFact: Cruise control can help a car use fuel more efficiently during a long, steady highway drive!

quests.instruction: Which word describes several people sharing one car ride together to save fuel and space?
quests.hint: Think about neighbors taking turns driving each other to work in just one shared car.
quests.explanation: A carpool is several people sharing one car ride. Carpools help save fuel and reduce traffic!
quests.funFact: Carpooling with friends or neighbors can help make a daily commute feel much more fun!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a program where people can rent a bicycle for a short ride around town?
quests.hint: Think about the racks of matching bicycles around a city that anyone can rent for a quick ride.
quests.explanation: A bike share is a program for renting bicycles for short rides. Bike shares help people travel around a city!
quests.funFact: A bike share program lets riders pick up a bike in one spot and drop it off in another!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a service where a driver uses their own car to give paid rides to passengers?
quests.hint: Think about calling a nearby driver with their own car to pick you up and take you somewhere for a fee.
quests.explanation: A ride share is a service where drivers give paid rides. Ride shares connect passengers with nearby drivers!
quests.funFact: A ride share app can show a passenger exactly when their driver will arrive!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a brief stop at another place partway through a longer journey?
quests.hint: Think about a short, planned stop at another city on the way to your final destination.
quests.explanation: A stopover is a brief stop partway through a journey. Travelers sometimes explore a city during a stopover!
quests.funFact: Some travelers enjoy exploring a whole new city during a long stopover!

quests.instruction: Which word describes a narrow indoor path connecting two areas, like inside an airport?
quests.hint: Think about the narrow indoor hallway connecting one part of a busy airport to another.
quests.explanation: A passageway is a narrow indoor path connecting two areas. Airports have long passageways between gates!
quests.funFact: Some airport passageways even have moving walkways to help tired travelers move along faster!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the amount of space for your legs in a vehicle's seat?
quests.hint: Think about how much space you have to stretch your legs out in front of your airplane seat.
quests.explanation: Legroom is the space for your legs in a seat. Extra legroom helps make a long trip more comfortable!
quests.funFact: Airlines sometimes offer seats with extra legroom for a little bit more comfort!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the storage compartment above your seat on an airplane?
quests.hint: Think about the compartment above your head on a plane where you slide your small suitcase.
quests.explanation: An overhead bin is a storage compartment above a seat. Passengers store small bags in the overhead bin!
quests.funFact: An overhead bin latches securely closed to keep bags safely in place during a flight!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the seat right next to the walkway on a plane or bus?
quests.hint: Think about the seat positioned right beside the walkway, easy to reach without climbing over anyone.
quests.explanation: An aisle seat is a seat next to the walkway. An aisle seat makes it easy to get up during a flight!
quests.funFact: Choosing an aisle seat makes it simple to stretch your legs or visit the restroom during a long flight!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the seat right beside the window on a plane or train?
quests.hint: Think about the seat right next to the little round window, perfect for watching the clouds go by.
quests.explanation: A window seat is a seat beside the window. A window seat lets you enjoy the view during a flight!
quests.funFact: A window seat gives travelers an amazing view of clouds, cities, and mountains far below!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the rectangular bag with wheels used to pack clothes for a trip?
quests.hint: Think about the rectangular bag with a handle and wheels that you fill with clothes before a trip.
quests.explanation: A suitcase is a bag used to pack clothes for a trip. Travelers roll a suitcase through the airport!
quests.funFact: Packing a suitcase neatly can help fit in a lot more for a trip!
